message.content: {"caption":"Blue lower-triangular heatmap of values across passage indices and self-edit iterations.","description":"A heatmap titled “Catastrophic Forgetting.” The horizontal axis is Passage Index, labeled 0–7; the vertical axis is Self-Edit Iteration, labeled 0–8. Each displayed cell has its value printed inside it. The filled cells form a lower-triangular pattern, with the upper-right cells blank. A blue color scale at right has labeled ticks from 0.20 to 0.40; lighter shades indicate lower values and darker shades higher values. The row for iteration 0 spans all passage indices and ranges from 0.25 to 0.34. Subsequent rows add one passage index at a time. Values for earlier passages tend to decline over later iterations, though not at every step: for example, passage 0 goes from 0.38 at iteration 1 to 0.19 at iterations 7 and 8. The newly added passage cells are generally among the darker, higher-valued cells; the largest printed value is 0.50 at iteration 2, passage
